rules.webExtension: Never replace the top-level document with ynxwallet://authorize. Use the accepted controlled hidden-frame lifecycle and keep the product page visible.
rules.native: Resolve an installed handler for the exact canonical request before opening it. Unsupported must preserve the product state and offer the official Wallet download plus an independent MetaMask route where applicable.
rules.truth: Launcher installed/opened/unsupported/timeout states never prove approval, callback, account, signing, transaction, Product Session, public deployment or ComputerControl verification.
rules.ownership: Only the registered product owner may change a product path. Consumers must not copy or rewrite the shared launcher or canonical request contract.
